The decision of the A&N Administration in all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance/rejection of applications, mode of selection, conduct of examination, allotment of centres, selection, and allotment of posts/organizations to selected candidates shall be final and binding; no enquiry/correspondence shall be entertained. content_sections.heading: A&N Administration Combined Matric Level Examination 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 1535 tentative vacancies have been announced across 194 post codes in multiple departments of the A&N Administration. The number of vacancies is tentative, based on input from indenting departments, and may increase or decrease at the sole discretion of the A&N Administration. Key departments include Directorate of Education (157 MTS), Department of Environment & Forests (110 Forest Guard), Directorate of Health Service, Directorate of Shipping Service, Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Service, Andaman Public Works Department, Agriculture, and many others. The table below shows a consolidated category-wise summary; post-code-wise details are in the notification. Abbreviations: UR – Unreserved, EWS – Economically Weaker Section, OBC-NCL – Other Backward Classes (Non-Creamy Layer), ST – Scheduled Tribes, PWDs – Persons with Benchmark Disability, ESM – Ex-Servicemen. Note: No SC (Scheduled Caste) reservation is applicable in A&N Islands as there are no SC communities notified for this Union Territory. Only Local Scheduled Tribe candidates covered under A&N Islands Scheduled Tribe Order 1959 are eligible for ST quota; other ST candidates will be considered only for UR vacancies. Only Local OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates as per specified Gazette Notifications are eligible for OBC reservation; other state OBC candidates from outside this UT will be considered only for UR vacancies. content_sections.heading: Who should NOT apply for A&N Administration Combined Matric Level Examination 2026?
content_sections.text: Candidates who are not Indian Nationals. Candidates who do not meet the educational qualification prescribed in Annexure-I for the specific post code they are applying for - qualifications vary widely from 10th pass to technical diploma/degree depending on the post. Candidates above the applicable age limit (33 years for Male / 38 years for Female for Group C UR) as on 28-06-2026 who do not qualify for any applicable age relaxation. OBC candidates from states other than A&N Islands applying under OBC reservation - only Local OBC (NCL) candidates as per specified Gazette Notifications of A&N Administration are eligible for OBC quota. Others will be treated as UR. ST candidates who are not from the local Scheduled Tribes of A&N Islands as per the Andaman & Nicobar Islands Scheduled Tribe Order 1959 - they will be considered only for UR vacancies, not ST quota. Candidates who fraudulently claim ST/OBC/EWS/ESM/PwD status - they will be permanently debarred from examinations conducted by the A&N Administration. Candidates who are not willing to work and be posted at locations within the A&N Islands (South Andaman, North & Middle Andaman, Nicobar Districts) - these are Union Territory government posts.

content_sections.heading: Common mistakes / What to check before applying A&N Administration Combined Matric Level Examination 2026?
content_sections.text: Applying for a post code without reading Annexure-I carefully - each of the 194 post codes has specific educational qualifications; applying under the wrong post code with mismatched qualification leads to rejection at document verification. OBC candidates from other states claiming OBC NCL reservation - only local A&N OBC (NCL) is valid for the OBC quota; mainland OBC candidates must apply as UR and pay the UR fee. Submitting OBC-NCL certificates older than two years from the closing date (27-07-2026) - the OBC-NCL certificate must not be older than two years from the closing date of the vacancy notice. Uploading poor quality or incorrect photographs/signatures - photograph must be 20 KB to 50 KB, resolution 200x230 (width x height) in jpg/jpeg; without cap/mask/glasses; plain white or off-white background; full face, front view, eyes open. Signature must be 10 KB to 20 KB, resolution 140x60 in jpeg. Applications with inappropriate photographs will be summarily rejected and may result in denial of entry to the examination hall. Not noting the preference order for posts during application - candidates should apply in order of their preferences; no request for change of preference of post will be entertained at a later stage. Not keeping registered email ID and mobile number active throughout the process - admit card, exam details, results, and call letters are sent only to the registered email/SMS; the A&N Administration is not responsible for bounced emails or undelivered SMS. Changing category after submission - once the online application is submitted, no request for change/correction/modification including change of category will be entertained under any circumstances. Waiting until the last date to apply - candidates are advised to apply much before 27-07-2026 to avoid server overload/connectivity issues; A&N Administration will not be responsible for last-minute failures.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions for A&N Administration Combined Matric Level Examination 2026 Candidates
content_sections.text: Candidature will be accepted only provisionally; the A&N Administration will not undertake detailed scrutiny at the time of TBT examination. Verification of eligibility, documents, and certificates will be done at the time of Online Document Verification stage. Candidates must carry printed e-Admit Card and one valid government-issued photo ID (in original) to the TBT examination - entry without Admit Card will not be allowed. The A&N Administration reserves the right to restrict entry to the examination venue till 09:30 AM. Banned items in examination hall: Mobile Phone, Micro Phone, Calculators, Pager, Digital Diary, Electronic/Smart Watch/Wrist Watches, Bluetooth devices, any other electronic/electrical devices, Book, and Notes are strictly prohibited. Possession of these items even in switched-off mode will be treated as use of unfair means. There is no provision for re-evaluation/re-checking of Answer Sheets/Scripts for TBT examinations. No correspondence in this regard will be entertained. All information/corrigendum/addendum regarding schedule of examinations, admit cards, results, etc. shall be posted only on the official website https://erecruitment.andamannicobar.gov.in - no separate information will be issued in print media. Candidates fraudulently claiming ST/OBC/EWS/ESM/PwD status will be permanently debarred from examinations conducted by the A&N Administration. Success in the examination confers no right of appointment unless the A&N Administration is satisfied that the candidate is suitable in all respects for appointment to the Government service/post; the decision of the A&N Administration is final and binding. The decision of the A&N Administration in all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance/rejection of applications, mode of selection, conduct of examination, allotment of centres, selection, and allotment of posts/organizations to selected candidates shall be final and binding; no enquiry/correspondence shall be entertained. Any dispute in regard to this recruitment shall be subject to Courts/Tribunals having jurisdiction over the A&N Administration only. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in A&N Administration Combined Matric Level Examination 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 1535 vacancies have been announced across 194 post codes in various departments of the Andaman & Nicobar Administration. The category-wise breakup is: UR – 704, ST – 129, OBC – 535, EWS – 167, plus 49 PwBD and 10 ESM as horizontal reservations. The number of vacancies is tentative and may increase or decrease at the sole discretion of the A&N Administration based on inputs from indenting departments.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for A&N Administration Matric Level Exam 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online applications is 27-07-2026 (up to 12:00 Midnight). The online application window opens on 08-06-2026 from 12:00 Noon. Applications must be submitted through the official portal https://erecruitment.andamannicobar.gov.in only; no physical applications will be accepted. Candidates are strongly advised to apply well before the closing date to avoid last-minute server congestion issues.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for A&N Administration Combined Matric Level Exam 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 100/- (Rupees One Hundred Only) payable through Net Banking, VISA/Master/Rupay/Credit/Debit Card, or UPI Payment/QR Code. Female candidates, ST candidates, and Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) candidates are fully exempted from the application fee. Fee once paid is non-refundable under any circumstances.

faq.question: Q4. What is the exam pattern for A&N Administration Combined Matric Level Exam 2026?
faq.answer: The Tier-I Tablet Based Test (TBT) consists of 150 questions (150 marks) in 120 minutes: General Intelligence & Reasoning (25Q/25M), Numerical Aptitude (25Q/25M), English Language (50Q/50M), and General Awareness (50Q/50M). Each question carries 1 mark; 0.25 marks are deducted for each wrong answer. VH/Cerebral Palsy candidates get 40 additional minutes (total 160 minutes). Questions for sections I, II, and IV are set in English and Hindi; English Language section is in English only. The Tier-II Physical/Skill/Trade Test (wherever applicable) is qualifying in nature only.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for A&N Administration Matric Level Exam 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 33 years for Male and 18 to 38 years for Female candidates (Group C posts) as on the closing date 28-06-2026. Age relaxation is applicable: ST candidates get 5 years; OBC (NCL) candidates get 3 years; PwBD (UR) gets 10 years; Ex-Servicemen get 3 years after deduction of military service. Central Government civilian employees with minimum 3 years regular continuous service can apply up to 40 years (45 years for ST). Candidates claiming relaxation fraudulently will be permanently debarred.

faq.question: Q6. Can OBC candidates from mainland India apply for A&N Administration Matric Level Exam 2026 under OBC reservation?
faq.answer: No. OBC reservation in A&N Administration is available exclusively to Local OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates covered under the specific Gazette Notifications (No.343/205/F.No.8-3/2003-TW dated 16th December 2005 and No. 752006/F.No.8-3/2003-TW dated 19th April 2006). OBC candidates from outside A&N Islands will be considered only against Unreserved (UR) vacancies. Similarly, only OBC-NCL certificates not older than 2 years from the closing date are valid for claiming OBC reservation.

faq.question: Q7. What documents are required at the time of A&N Administration TBT examination?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry: (1) Printed copy of the e-Admit Card downloaded from the official portal; (2) One valid government-issued photo ID in original - Islander Card, Pan Card, Voter ID Card, Driving License, or Aadhaar Card issued by Government of India; and (3) One recent passport-size photograph. Mobile phones, calculators, smart watches, Bluetooth devices, and any other electronic gadgets are strictly prohibited inside the exam hall - even in switched-off mode.

faq.question: Q8. Is there negative marking in A&N Administration Matric Level Exam 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, there is negative marking. For each wrong answer, 0.25 marks (one-fourth of the mark) will be deducted. Each question carries 1 mark, so attempting a question incorrectly results in a net loss of 0.25 marks. There is no deduction for unattempted questions. Candidates are strongly advised to keep this in mind while answering - avoid random guessing. There is also no provision for re-evaluation or re-checking of answer sheets/scripts.

faq.question: Q9. What is the Tier-II examination in A&N Administration Combined Matric Level Exam 2026?
faq.answer: Tier-II consists of Physical Standard Examination / Physical Measurement and Endurance Test / Skill / Trade Test, wherever prescribed as essential qualification for the specific post (as per Annexure-I of the notification). It is conducted by the concerned department for candidates who qualify in Tier-I TBT. Importantly, the Tier-II test is only of qualifying nature - it does not contribute to the final merit score. Final selection is based solely on Tier-I TBT marks, subject to qualifying the Tier-II test where applicable.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Andaman & Nicobar Islands apply for A&N Administration Matric Level Exam 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, any eligible Indian National can apply. However, candidates from outside A&N Islands applying under ST or OBC reservation will not get the benefit of these reservations - they will be treated as Unreserved (UR) category candidates. Only Local Scheduled Tribe candidates of A&N Islands (as per Scheduled Tribe Order 1959) and Local OBC (NCL) candidates (as per specified A&N Gazette Notifications) are eligible for reserved quota benefits. All selected candidates must be willing to serve in posts/departments located in the Andaman & Nicobar Islands.
